title: The shape of quark flavors
abstract: arXiv:2609.22812v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We construct the Yukawa couplings of the quark sector as overlap integrals of Gaussian wave functions in extra spatial dimensions. Assuming that the wave function of each chiral fermion is localised at a point in the extra dimensions, while that of the Higgs doublet is flat, the Yukawa matrix elements are determined by the relative positions of the three left-handed quark doublets, $q_1$, $q_2$, $q_3$, and the six right-handed quark singlets, $u_1$, $u_2$, $u_3$, $d_1$, $d_2$, $d_3$. We employ numerical optimisation techniques from machine learning to identify field configurations that satisfy all current experimental constraints on the quark Yukawa sector. In this framework, the large hierarchy of quark masses arises naturally, since the overlap integrals of Gaussian wave functions are exponentially sensitive to ${\mathcal O}(1)$ separations in the extra dimensions.

translated_abstract: 我们将夸克部分的汤川耦合构造为额外空间维度中高斯波函数的重叠积分。假设每个手性费米子的波函数局域于额外维度中的某一点，而希格斯二重态的波函数是平坦的，则汤川矩阵元由三个左手夸克二重态 $q_1$、$q_2$、$q_3$ 与六个右手夸克单态 $u_1$、$u_2$、$u_3$、$d_1$、$d_2$、$d_3$ 的相对位置决定。我们采用源自机器学习的数值优化技术，寻找满足当前夸克汤川部分所有实验约束的场位形。在这一框架下，夸克质量的巨大等级结构得以自然产生，因为高斯波函数的重叠积分对额外维度中 ${\mathcal O}(1)$ 量级的间隔呈指数敏感性。
tldr: 该论文提出将夸克汤川耦合解释为额外维度中局域高斯波函数的重叠积分，并借助机器学习数值优化找到了满足所有实验约束的场位置配置，从而自然解释了夸克质量的巨大等级结构。
en_tdlr: This paper interprets quark Yukawa couplings as overlap integrals of localized Gaussian wavefunctions in extra dimensions, using machine-learning-based numerical optimization to find field configurations satisfying all experimental constraints, thereby naturally explaining the large quark mass hierarchy.
